subject: Aurora capacity top-up: PO delivery, payor switch & Net45 confirmation
messages:
From: Rachel Morgan <rachel.morgan@aurora.com>

Cc: Aurora Procurement <procurement@aurora.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity renewal + PO for Q4 increase

Hi Karthik,

Following our call this morning, Aurora is confirming a Q4 Dedicated capacity top-up of ~20% over our current commit. Procurement is preparing the PO and asked that we get billing details aligned before they route payment. A couple of items we need from Redwood to close this on our side: 

- Can Redwood accept PO #3456 and have it referenced on the invoice?
- Our finance team is requesting Net45 on this specific add-on (we typically run Net30). Is that possible?
- We need billing routed to our central payor (Finance Ops <finance@aurora.com>) rather than the product team contact currently on file; the PO will include the payor name and EIN.
- If Redwood needs a W9 or other tax forms, please send them along.

Im copying Procurement so they can attach the PO once legal finishes formatting. We can sign the addendum via DocuSign  let me know if youd like us to sign your link or if youll send one.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Morgan
Head of Renewals | Aurora Cloud

Attachment: (PO will be attached by procurement in next reply)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aurora Procurement <procurement@aurora.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + PO for Q4 increase

Hi Rachel  great to hear and thanks for the details. Short answers and next steps below.

- PO: We can accept PO #3456. Please ensure the PO references DEAL-2028-088-AUR and includes the billing entity name + EIN for tax mapping.
- Invoice: Ive attached a draft invoice that references the existing contract and the Q4 capacity addendum.
- Net terms: Redwood can approve Net45 for this one-time capacity top-up (approval reference FS-NEGO-88). Ive looped Marissa from Finance to confirm bank/ACH details and finalize the terms.
- Payor switch: We can route billing to Finance Ops <finance@aurora.com>. If youre splitting payment across payors, please attach a short allocation worksheet (amount or percentage per payor) and indicate which legal entity will submit the PO.

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Q4_2028.pdf; Redwood_W9.pdf; SOW_Aurora_Q4_addendum.docx

Next steps:
1) Procurement sends final PO (with EIN + invoice instructions) and the allocation worksheet if splitting payors.
2) Marissa will confirm Net45 and provide wire/ACH details.
3) Well circulate a DocuSign envelope for the addendum and invoice acceptance once PO and payor details are received.

Marissa / Vivek  anything else we should flag for Aurora?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub descriptions: Redwood_Invoice_Q4_2028.pdf (draft invoice, references DEAL-2028-088-AUR); Redwood_W9.pdf (Redwood W-9); SOW_Aurora_Q4_addendum.docx (capacity addendum, redline)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + PO for Q4 increase 

Hi Rachel,

Thanks  Marissa from Redwood Finance here. Weve approved Net45 for this add-on as a one-off concession. To complete invoicing and mapping we need the following on the PO file:

- Legal payor name exactly as it appears on the EIN record
- EIN / Tax ID (required to issue invoice to that entity)
- Billing address and contact (email for remittance: finance@aurora.com)
- If splitting payment across multiple payors, please provide the allocation table (amounts or percentages) and which entity will sign the PO.

Once we receive the PO with the above fields we will:
1) Issue the final invoice referencing PO #3456 and DEAL-2028-088-AUR.
2) Send bank wiring and ACH instructions (I will include both options).
3) Create a DocuSign envelope for the SOW addendum that includes the invoice acknowledgment.

For transparency: Net45 approval is documented under internal case FS-NEGO-88. If Aurora wants Net45 to be standard for future renewals, wed need to scope a short finance review and update the billing policy; we can discuss that separately.

Bank/ACH (sample)
- Bank: Redwood Bank, NA
- Wire: Redwood Bank NA, Routing 123456789, Account 987654321
- ACH: Redwood ACH Routing 111222333, Account 987654321

Please attach the PO and, if applicable, the allocation spreadsheet. Ive included a placeholder file name we can use when Aurora uploads the split-payor sheet: Aurora_Payor_Allocation.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
